turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good afternoon. I've recently retired, and a neighbour has invited me to her bridge club. I've never played a card game in my life.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Congratulations on retiring. Bridge is a wonderful game to learn, very social, though it does take a little while.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How long, would you say, before I'm not a burden at the table?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: With a beginners' class, a couple of months to play comfortably. Many clubs run lessons, ask your neighbour if hers does.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And what is bridge, in a nutshell?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Four players in two partnerships try to win tricks, which are rounds of one card each. First you bid on how many tricks you'll take, then you try to make it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It is at first, but each part is simple on its own. And clubs are usually very patient with newcomers, they want more players.
